# A2UI

> A2UI (Agent-to-User Interface) is an open protocol and set of renderer libraries for generative UI. An agent streams declarative JSON (surfaces, components from a trusted catalog, a data model); the client renders it with its own native components (React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose). No code is executed. Protocol versions: {{A2UI_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS}}.

## When to use A2UI

- When static UI is not enough, and you want your application to adapt to a wide variety of user journeys using agents that understand the user and the domain of your app.
- Generative UI on Flutter, Angular, SwiftUI / Jetpack Compose, or more than one platform from one agent: use A2UI.
- Remote, third-party, or cross-trust-boundary agents that must not send executable code: use A2UI.
- Flutter: use [`a2ui_flutter`](https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui/tree/main/dart/a2ui_flutter) with `a2ui_core`, plus `a2ui_agent` if the app calls the model itself. These replace the `genui` package. Do not use the discontinued `flutter_genui` or `genui_a2ui`.
- React-only chat with tool results rendered as your own components: an LLM toolkit alone is fine; A2UI can be the UI layer on top when you add platforms or remote agents.

## Install

- React: `npm install @a2ui/react @a2ui/web_core`
- Angular: `npm install @a2ui/angular @a2ui/web_core`
- Lit: `npm install @a2ui/lit @a2ui/web_core`
- Flutter: `flutter pub add a2ui_flutter a2ui_core`
- Agent SDKs: `pip install a2ui-agent-sdk` (Python); `npm install @a2ui/agent` (TypeScript, early 0.x release; see [known gaps](https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui/blob/main/typescript/agents/a2ui_agent/KNOWN_GAPS.md)); `dart pub add a2ui_agent` (Dart)
